name: Offline observability fixture
description: Check the relationship between a failed request, its spans and a log. The fictional fixture includes a later recovery, an independent control and missing, duplicate and unsupported signals.

evidence.note: The catalogue has no committed run receipt. Run the offline fixture and open its JSON result below.

limits: These are fictional request, log and trace records. Their timings come from the fixture timestamps.
The checks run locally with zero provider use or spend. Live telemetry delivery, incident diagnosis and remediation require separate evidence.
